entities.summary: New Era University (NEU) is a private educational institution in the Philippines, run by the Iglesia ni Cristo (INC). Although it is associated with the INC, it is a non-sectarian university. Its main campus is at New Era, Quezon City, within the Central Office Complex of the INC, since 1986. Aside from its flagship Quezon City campus, it has four other campuses around the Philippines, including one in San Fernando City (Pampanga), in Lipa City (Batangas), in General Santos, and in Baras (Rizal). New Era University is a university in Asia, established in 1975. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: New Era University has played a significant role in shaping education in Southeast Asia, with its flagship campus established in 1986 and four additional campuses across the Philippines. Its non-sectarian approach has made it an important institution for regional higher education.
